description: Use when you need to know whether a product you picked still works as it did, or what moved lately: with a slug, every dated change at that product (level, surfaces, price and plan, each with its source); without, the level moves of the last days, newest first, with the cause and the level now. Its full drive result: get_provider. Read-only, no key needed; narrow it with days or category.

category.description: Only this category: an id or name from list_categories

days.description: How many days back to look, 1 to 31 (default 7)

slug.description: Only this product: its slug from search_tools. Adds changes, its every public change since its first drive

name: list_changes
title: What changed lately
